-- ============================================
-- MM2 Full Trade Bot v3 — Brute Force Accept
-- Generated by Cobalt — https://gitlab.com/upio/cobalt
-- Fires AcceptTrade on loop until trade closes
-- ============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Trade = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Trade", 10)
local SendRequest = Trade:WaitForChild("SendRequest", 10)
local OfferItem   = Trade:WaitForChild("OfferItem", 10)
local AcceptTrade = Trade:WaitForChild("AcceptTrade", 10)

local TARGET_USERNAME = "aquxtic_jaz"
local ITEM_DATAID     = "Strawberries_G_2026"
local ITEM_TYPE       = "Weapons"

-- *doesn't ask twice. fires until the door opens.*

local function safeCall(fn, label)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    print("[CobaltBot] " .. label .. (ok and " ✓" or " FAILED: " .. tostring(err)))
end

local function getTarget()
    local t = 0
    local target
    repeat
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
        target = Players:FindFirstChild(TARGET_USERNAME)
    until target or t >= 15
    return target
end

-- brute click every button that could be accept
local function bruteClickAccept(gui)
    local keywords = {
        "accept", "Accept", "ACCEPT",
        "AcceptButton", "AcceptBtn", "Confirm",
        "confirm", "Ready", "ready", "Ok", "OK"
    }
    local clicked = false
    for _, desc in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("GuiButton") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("ImageButton") then
            for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
                if desc.Name:find(kw) or (desc:IsA("TextButton") and desc.Text:find(kw)) then
                    pcall(function() desc.MouseButton1Click:Fire() end)
                    pcall(function() desc.Activated:Fire() end)
                    clicked = true
                    print("[CobaltBot] Clicked: " .. desc:GetFullName())
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return clicked
end

local function run()
    print("[CobaltBot] Starting — looking for " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. "...")

    local target = getTarget()
    if not target then
        warn("[CobaltBot] " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. " not found. Stopping.")
        return
    end
    print("[CobaltBot] Found target ✓")

    -- send request
    safeCall(function()
        SendRequest:InvokeServer(target)
    end, "SendRequest")

    -- wait for GUI open
    local desktopGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI", 30)
    local phoneGui   = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI_Phone", 30)
    local tradeGui   = nil
    local guiOpened  = false

    local function onOpen(gui)
        if not guiOpened then
            guiOpened = true
            tradeGui = gui
        end
    end

    local c1 = desktopGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if desktopGui.Enabled then onOpen(desktopGui) end
    end)
    local c2 = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if phoneGui.Enabled then onOpen(phoneGui) end
    end)

    local t = 0
    while not guiOpened and t < 30 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
    end
    c1:Disconnect()
    c2:Disconnect()

    if not guiOpened then
        warn("[CobaltBot] Trade never opened. Stopping.")
        return
    end

    print("[CobaltBot] Trade GUI open ✓")
    task.wait(0.5)

    -- offer item
    safeCall(function()
        OfferItem:FireServer(ITEM_DATAID, ITEM_TYPE)
    end, "OfferItem")

    -- wait 6s for MM2 accept timer
    print("[CobaltBot] Waiting 6s for accept window...")
    task.wait(6)

    -- fire AcceptTrade remote on loop + brute click buttons
    -- runs until TradeGUI closes
    local tradeDone = false
    local closeConn
    closeConn = tradeGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if not tradeGui.Enabled then
            tradeDone = true
            closeConn:Disconnect()
        end
    end)

    local attempts = 0
    while not tradeDone and attempts < 20 do
        -- fire remote directly
        safeCall(function()
            AcceptTrade:FireServer()
        end, "AcceptTrade attempt " .. attempts + 1)

        -- also brute click GUI buttons
        bruteClickAccept(tradeGui)

        attempts = attempts + 1
        task.wait(0.4)
    end

    print("[CobaltBot] Done — leaving in 1.5s...")
    task.wait(1.5)
    TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end

task.spawn(run)
